import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(11.2, 22.7)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(9.2)
    .extrude(24.1)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .slot2D(18, 7)
    .cutBlind(-7)
)
show_object(result)

import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(11.2, 22.7)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(9.2)
    .extrude(24.1)
)
result = result.faces('>Z').workplane(centerOption='CenterOfBoundBox').slot2D(18.00,7.00).cutBlind(-7.00)
